sources.title: Model Architecture | QwenLM/Qwen2.5-VL | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL utilize a vision-language architecture that integrates a specialized vision encoder with a large language model (LLM) backbone. The system is designed to handle diverse modalities including images, multi-page documents, and hours-long videos through a unified processing pipeline.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL: Advanced Vision-Language Model
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-VL is a multimodal model that integrates a dynamic-resolution Vision Transformer with efficient window attention and MRoPE to support arbitrary spatial and temporal scales. It addresses tasks from visual question answering to long-video comprehension using innovative pretraining and reinforcement fine-tuning methods.
